purpose: Index of pastor-statement and organizational-affiliation reference files used by the MOOP church directory for the 'people is policy' cross-reference. Future enrichment waves should auto-cross-check new churches against every list registered here.

lists.label: Warhurst Protest
lists.description: PCA Hall of Infamy — pastors who signed a December 2020 protest against discipline of a Revoice-friendly pastor. Marker of the soft-progressive PCA wing.

lists.label: Alliance for Mission and Renewal
lists.description: Soft-progressive PCA advocacy 501(c)(3) (EIN 92-4022322, Marriottsville MD) in the Tim Keller / Redeemer-network mold. Pushes 'unity, faithfulness, flourishing' framing — code for resisting the conservative confessionalist GRN-aligned wing on women's roles, sexuality post-Revoice, and Kellerite urban missiology.

lists.label: PCA Letter of Lament (Call to Prayer & Lament)
lists.description: December 2025 open letter spearheaded by Irwyn Ince (former MNA Director) and Duke Kwon, lamenting 'schismatic culture,' sidelining of minorities and women, doctrinal 'rigidity,' and racial microaggressions in the PCA. 224 claimed signers (only 17 publicly named).

lists.label: Revoice (Side B sexuality movement)
lists.description: Speakers, endorsers, and platform-givers of the Revoice conferences (2018-2026). The Side B / 'gay Christian' / sexual-minority-affirming-but-celibate-rhetoric movement. Sexual-ethics drift marker. PCA cluster densely concentrated at Memorial Pres + Covenant Theological Seminary + Missouri Presbytery.

lists.label: Christians for Biblical Equality (CBE International)
lists.description: Leading evangelical egalitarian advocacy organization (founded 1988). Direct ideological counter to CBMW. Pastors and theologians associated with CBE explicitly affirm women in pastoral and elder roles — fails MOOP's male-headship rubric. Heavy in Wesleyan, ECC, Free Methodist, mainline UMC, Anglican (UK/Africa).

lists.label: Statement on Social Justice & the Gospel (Dallas Statement)
lists.description: Post-2018 'Big Eva split' marker against CRT, woke evangelicalism, and feminized social justice. Authored by John MacArthur, Voddie Baucham, Tom Ascol, Phil Johnson, James White, Anthony Kidd, Justin Peters, Darrell B. Harrison. Signers cluster around Founders Ministries, G3 Conference, Grace to You / Master's Seminary, Alpha & Omega, Sovereign Nations, Reformed Baptist + SBC conservative wing. TGC/Keller-aligned leaders conspicuously absent.

lists.label: Nashville Statement on Biblical Sexuality
lists.description: 2017 CBMW statement on biblical anthropology, marriage, and sexual ethics. The pre-Big-Eva-split orthodox sexual-ethics line. Broader tent than Dallas — includes both Reformed-conservative and Kellerite-adjacent figures (though Tim Keller himself did NOT sign, which is the historical origin of the Kellerite-vs-Nashville framing). Signers include MacArthur, Mohler, Piper, Carson, Packer, Sproul (d.), Grudem, MacDonald (later removed), Russell Moore, J.I. Packer (d.), Storms, Akin, Strachan, Lambert, DeYoung, Voddie Baucham, Mbewe, Beeke.

rubric.computation: If pastor signatories include any of dallas/nashville → 'green' weight. If pastor signatories include any of warhurst/amr/lament/revoice/cbe → 'red' weight. Both → 'mixed' (warrants explicit human review). Neither → 'none' (no signal).
rubric.interpretation: These are evidence-weighted signals about doctrinal trajectory, NOT the sole determinant of any church's overall rating. A green signal CONFIRMS but does not by itself elevate to GREEN; a red signal is a strong negative marker that justifies score-note enrichment and (depending on rubric severity per the brief) downgrade from green to yellow with cultural=red.

cross_check_methodology.matching: Strict full-name match (first + last) on pastor field, after stripping honorifics (Dr./Pastor/Rev./etc.) and suffixes (Jr./Sr./III/etc.).
cross_check_methodology.corroboration: For large lists (Dallas 13K, Nashville 22K), state-corroboration is required: signer's location/institution must contain the same 2-letter state code as the church's address. For Nashville-attributed signers (the 176 with church_or_institution metadata), additional institution-name overlap is required to reduce false positives from common-name homonyms.
cross_check_methodology.false_positive_safeguards: (1) Strict full-name match (not first-initial). (2) State corroboration on large lists. (3) Institution-name token overlap on attributed Nashville signers. (4) Manual review of any cross-list overlaps that contradict expected polarity (e.g., a Dallas signer also showing up on Warhurst would warrant verification of homonym vs. real anomaly).
cross_check_methodology.expected_polarity: Dallas and Nashville share heavy overlap (both green); they should have ZERO overlap with Warhurst/AMR/Lament/Revoice/CBE (all red). Any unexpected overlap is either a homonym (common) or a documented case of pastor-trajectory-shift (rare; document explicitly when found).
